tips_summary: Use broad-spectrum sunscreen daily and keep the routine gentle and moisturizing. For persistent pigmentation, seek a dermatologist's advice before trying targeted treatments.

tips.title: Sun protection
points: Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher each morning.
Reapply outdoors and use a hat or shade for added protection.

tips.title: Gentle routine
points: Cleanse with a mild, non-scrubbing cleanser.
Use a fragrance-free moisturizer to support the skin barrier.

treatment: Maintain consistent daily sun protection to help prevent further discoloration.
Ask a dermatologist about suitable pigment-targeting ingredients, such as azelaic acid or a retinoid.
Consider professional options for uneven pigmentation only after an in-person skin assessment.
